learning_outcomes.text: Understand the concept of a company, types of companies, and the environment in which it operates.
Be able to understand the different subsystems that integrate a company.
Understand the principles of business organization and management.

syllabus_topics: Functioning of economic activity and types of markets
Concept and objectives of the company
Types of company: economic, organizational, and legal criteria
Asset and results analysis for decision-making
Valuation of investment and financing projects
assessment_rules: The ordinary assessment consists of a final theoretical-practical written exam (EX.ORD) worth a maximum of 6.5 points, requiring a minimum of 2.6 points. Three evaluable practices (P1, P2, P3) each worth 1 point, and participation (P) worth 0.5 points, require a minimum of 1.4 points combined (P1+P2+P3+P). The final grade is calculated as NOTA FINAL = EX.ORD + P1 + P2 + P3 + P, with a minimum of 5 points required to pass. If the final score is above 5 points but a minimum is not met, the final grade will be 4 points. For extraordinary exams, students can retake the theoretical-practical exam (EX.EXTR, max 6.5 points, min 2.6 points) and/or a practical exam (EX.PR, max 3.5 points, min 1.4 points), with ordinary exam scores retained if minimums were met. Penalties for incorrect syntax or spelling apply.
